title: Risk Scoring Configuration Schema
description: Schema for configuring risk assessment mappings following ISO 27005 methodology. Risk Score = Likelihood x Impact.

impact.description: Maps module type to default impact rating (1-5). Use '_default' for fallback value when type is not found.

criticality.description: Maps module type to criticality level for AI risk analysis context. Use '_default' for fallback value.

severity_weights.description: Severity-to-likelihood weights for base likelihood calculation. Base likelihood is 1, then add weight based on highest severity found.

critical.description: Weight for CRITICAL severity findings (results in likelihood up to 5)
